hope: Spend 3 Hope to clear a Hit Point on an ally within Close range.

features.name: Prayer Dice
features.short: At the start of each session, roll d4s equal to your subclass’s Spellcast trait and place them on your sheet. Spend any number to aid yourself or an ally within Far range: reduce incoming damage by a die’s value, add it to a roll’s result after the roll, or gain Hope equal to it. Clear unspent dice at session end.

seraph.divine-wielder.name: Spirit Weapon
seraph.divine-wielder.short: An equipped Melee or Very Close weapon can fly from your hand to attack an adversary within Close range and return. Mark a Stress to target an additional adversary within range with the same roll.

seraph.divine-wielder.name: Sparing Touch
seraph.divine-wielder.short: Once per long rest, touch a creature and clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress from them.

seraph.divine-wielder.name: Devout
seraph.divine-wielder.short: When you roll Prayer Dice, roll an additional die and discard the lowest. Use Sparing Touch twice per long rest.

seraph.divine-wielder.name: Sacred Resonance
seraph.divine-wielder.short: When you roll Spirit Weapon damage, matching dice double their value (two 5s count as two 10s).

seraph.winged-sentinel.name: Wings of Light
seraph.winged-sentinel.short: You can fly. While flying: mark a Stress to carry another willing creature of about your size or smaller; spend a Hope to deal an extra 1d8 damage on a successful attack.

seraph.winged-sentinel.name: Ethereal Visage
seraph.winged-sentinel.short: While flying, advantage on Presence Rolls. When you succeed with Hope on a Presence Roll, you can remove a Fear from the GM’s Fear pool instead of gaining Hope.

seraph.winged-sentinel.name: Ascendant
seraph.winged-sentinel.short: Permanent +4 to your Severe damage threshold.

seraph.winged-sentinel.name: Power of the Gods
seraph.winged-sentinel.short: While flying, Wings of Light deals an extra 1d12 instead of 1d8.
